feature.name: One-tap reorder
feature.summary: Grocery customers repeat their last order in a few taps: check items, pick a slot, pay with the saved card.

funnel.name: Confirms payment with the saved card

hypotheses.text: At least 60% of customers who open the sheet place the order.
At least 25% of all active customers use it.
At least 10% of new customers use it.

edge_cases.title: No connection
edge_cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
edge_cases.expected: Keep the basket and slot, say the order was not placed, retry when back online.

edge_cases.title: No answer in time
edge_cases.question: After how long does it give up, and what can the user do then?
edge_cases.expected: After a time limit, show the definite order state (looked up on the server) instead of a generic error.

edge_cases.title: The other system returns an error
edge_cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
edge_cases.expected: Specific message, safe retry, basket and slot kept.

edge_cases.title: Button pressed twice
edge_cases.question: Can a double press create two records, charges or messages?
edge_cases.expected: A second press must not create a second order or charge. Disable the button on press and make the request idempotent.

edge_cases.title: Half of it worked
edge_cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
edge_cases.expected: If payment succeeds but the order fails (or the reverse), reconcile automatically and tell the customer which state they are in.

edge_cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
edge_cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
edge_cases.expected: If a price or stock level changed between review and placement, show the change and ask once before charging.

edge_cases.title: Nothing to show yet
edge_cases.question: What does a first-time or zero-data user see, and what should they do next?
edge_cases.expected: A customer with no past order should not see the entry points, or should see a starter basket.
edge_cases.note: The spec lists this as undecided; in the simulation about nine in ten new customers who start are blocked.

edge_cases.step_name: Confirms payment with the saved card
edge_cases.title: Saved card is expired or will be declined
edge_cases.question: When is the card checked, and what happens to the basket and slot if it fails?
edge_cases.expected: Check the expiry date when the sheet opens; on decline, stay in the flow, hold the slot, offer another payment method.

edge_cases.title: Customer wants only some of the items
edge_cases.question: Can items be unticked or quantities changed?
edge_cases.expected: Allow untick and quantity change in the sheet; otherwise one-off orders make reorder useless.

edge_cases.title: Signed out while in the flow
edge_cases.question: After signing in again, do they return to where they were?
edge_cases.expected: Sign in again and return to the same step with the basket intact.
edge_cases.note: Lower than the default: sessions on a phone app rarely expire inside a one-minute flow.

edge_cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation
edge_cases.question: If the step fails or the user steps back, is what they typed kept?
edge_cases.expected: A slot error must not reset stock decisions made in the previous step.

edge_cases.title: Second and tenth use
edge_cases.question: Is the repeat experience shorter than the first, and are earlier choices remembered?
edge_cases.expected: On repeat use, remember the usual slot and substitute choices.

edge_cases.title: Most or all items are unavailable
edge_cases.question: What does the sheet show when little of the last order can be bought today?
edge_cases.expected: Say so up front and offer the regular shop instead of an empty reorder.

edge_cases.title: Removing items drops the basket below the minimum order value
edge_cases.question: Is the minimum checked after removals, and what is offered?
edge_cases.expected: Show the shortfall and suggest items to add.

edge_cases.title: Page refresh or app restart mid-flow
edge_cases.question: Is progress restored or does the user start again?

edge_cases.title: Link opens the middle of the flow
edge_cases.question: What happens if someone lands on step 3 without doing steps 1 and 2?

edge_cases.title: Same flow open in two tabs or devices
edge_cases.question: Which one wins, and can the two conflict?

edge_cases.title: Role or access changes mid-flow
edge_cases.question: If access is removed while the user is in the flow, what do they see?

edge_cases.title: Interrupted and resumed days later
edge_cases.question: Is a half-done flow kept, expired or cleaned up, and is the user reminded?

edge_cases.title: Keyboard only
edge_cases.question: Can the whole flow be completed without a mouse, in a sensible focus order?

edge_cases.title: Screen reader
edge_cases.question: Are states, errors and progress announced?

edge_cases.title: Small phone screen

qualitative.note: Think-aloud walkthroughs played by Claude in persona, against spec.md. Qualitative evidence only.

sessions.persona: Meera, weekly regular, orders every Sunday
sessions.goal: Repeat last week's basket before the kids wake up

moments.thought: Milk went up. Is this today's price or last week's? I can't tell which prices changed.
I always take Sunday 6 to 8pm. Why am I scrolling a slot list again?
Done in about a minute. That is what I wanted.

sessions.quote: It saved me the basket building, then made me do the slot dance anyway.

sessions.persona: Arjun, weekly regular on the commute

moments.thought: Two items are greyed out. Do I have to fix both before I can go on? There is no 'remove all unavailable'.
Spinner, then 'Something went wrong'. Did it charge me? Did the order go through? I am not pressing it again.

sessions.quote: I don't know if I just bought groceries or not.
sessions.unmet_need: A clear answer on whether the order was placed, and a safe retry.

sessions.persona: Sana, occasional shopper, orders once a month
sessions.context: mobile, good network, no saved card

moments.thought: Last order was for a party. I don't want 12 bottles of soda again. Can I untick things?
It says 'Pay with saved card' but I never saved one. The button is just disabled.

sessions.quote: It walked me all the way to the end and then shut the door.
sessions.unmet_need: Add a card here, or tell me at the start.

sessions.goal: Check whether a reorder is cheaper than building a new basket

moments.thought: Total is higher than last time. Which items? I want a 'what changed' line.
The substitute for my coffee is a different brand at a higher price. Is that chosen for me? I will just build the basket myself.

sessions.quote: If I have to check every line anyway, it is not one tap.
sessions.unmet_need: Show price and stock changes at the top, with one decision for all of them.

sessions.persona: Priya, new customer, installed the app yesterday
sessions.context: mobile, good network, no past order

moments.thought: The banner says 'Reorder in one tap'. I tap it and get an empty sheet. Reorder what?

sessions.quote: Why show me a reorder button when I have never ordered?
sessions.unmet_need: Do not show it to me yet, or offer a starter basket.

sessions.persona: Kabir, weekly regular whose card expired last month
sessions.context: mobile, good network, saved card expired

moments.thought: It shows my card ending 4421. Looks fine.
Payment declined. Now I am back on the home screen and my slot is gone.

sessions.quote: It let me confirm a card it could have known was expired.
sessions.unmet_need: Check the card before the last step and keep my slot while I fix it.

themes.title: The flow ends in a locked door for people without a usable card
themes.evidence: Sana (no card) and Kabir (expired card) both reached the last steps before learning they could not pay.
themes.recommendation: Check payment readiness when the sheet opens; let users add or update a card inline and keep the slot held.

themes.title: A failed order leaves the customer unsure whether they paid
themes.evidence: Arjun on a flaky network would not retry because the outcome was unclear.
themes.recommendation: Make order placement idempotent, show the definite state (placed or not placed), and offer a safe retry.

themes.title: 'One tap' breaks as soon as anything changed since last time
themes.evidence: Price changes and out-of-stock items forced line-by-line review for Meera, Dev and Arjun.
themes.recommendation: Summarise what changed at the top and offer one decision: accept suggested substitutes, or remove unavailable items.

themes.title: New customers are promised something they cannot use
themes.evidence: Priya opened an empty reorder sheet.
themes.recommendation: Hide the entry points until there is a past order, or replace them with a starter basket.

spec_gaps.title: Partial reorder is not specified
spec_gaps.detail: Can a customer untick items or change quantities, or is it all-or-nothing?

spec_gaps.title: Expired or declined card
spec_gaps.detail: The spec lists this as undecided; it is the most damaging late failure in the flow.

spec_gaps.title: Slot held or not during the flow
spec_gaps.detail: If the slot fills while the customer fixes stock or payment, what happens?

spec_gaps.title: Which order is 'the last order'
spec_gaps.detail: Most recent, most frequent, or a saved favourite? A one-off party order makes a poor default.
